topic.original: Under what conditions should policy-makers mandate specific data-handling and design constraints for AI developers to ensure that the causal pathways of model training and algorithmic engagement prioritize developmental safety? This inquiry requires navigating the tension between the push for hyper-personalized model optimization and the preservation of minor autonomy, while balancing the distributed responsibilities of developers, regulators, and guardians.
